title: Functional Testing Scenarios
summary: Defines functional validation scenarios for the Nuvei commercetools connector across checkout, payment intents, DMNs, deployment, and readiness.
notes: Manifest declared DOC; classification uses manifest override. Filename hash unavailable in this subagent because no hashing tool was available, so stable basename-derived ID was used per orchestrator guidance.
requirements: Run processor and enabler npm test and npm run build before manual payment testing.
Processor /config must return safe frontend Nuvei configuration to session-authenticated clients without secrets.
Processor /status must report commercetools permission checks and Nuvei reachability without leaking secrets.
Processor must advertise only payment methods the enabler can build, including card component and embedded drop-in when supported.
Enabler must load the Nuvei SafeCharge SDK once per page lifecycle and mount components without duplicate script tags.
Complete Checkout and Payment Only card authorization must succeed in sandbox and reconcile with CT Payments and Nuvei transactions.
Declined cards and failed or abandoned 3DS flows must fail safely without exposing sensitive data or creating false successful payments.
Frontend confirmation and DMN reconciliation must be idempotent and avoid duplicate CT transactions.
Capture, partial capture, cancel authorization, refund, partial refund, and reverse flows must use the correct Nuvei transaction IDs and CT transaction types.
Duplicate DMNs, invalid DMN checksums, missing payment correlation, amount or currency mismatches, unauthorized sessions, and wrong-cart confirmations must be rejected safely.
Nuvei outages or timeouts must fail safely and avoid unrecoverable partial CT Payment state.
Deployment hooks must log the correct DMN URL and clear cleanup guidance.
Documentation must match repository layout, package manager assumptions, implemented endpoints, test locations, and accepted limitations.
constraints: Use npm install, npm test, and npm run build commands for both processor and enabler packages.
Session-protected frontend routes include POST /payments and POST /payments/confirmPayments/:paymentId.
Operational routes include GET /config, GET /status, and GET /payment-components.
Payment intent operations are triggered through POST /payment-intents/:paymentId.
Safe responses and logs must not expose NUVEI_SECRET_KEY, CT client credentials, checksums, tokens, raw card data, or session tokens.
Supported advertised payment methods are card component and embedded drop-in only when implemented; wallets and APMs must not be advertised unless implemented.
DMN idempotency is based on avoiding duplicate CT transactions with the same Nuvei interaction ID.
Invalid checksums should return 400 and leave CT Payments unchanged.
Amount and currency mismatches must not alter payment state.
Known DMN correlation gaps around merchant_unique_id must be resolved before production readiness.
Card-first MVP completion requires CI automation for build and test commands and documentation alignment with runtime behavior.
